title: Low: DraftDateCell's hidden date input is a second, invisible Tab stop in Chromium
evidence: From PR 1724 (H89). widget-src/src/components/DraftDateCell.tsx: the button holds a 1px, opacity-0 input[type=date] (.bt-date-hidden-icon) that is still in the Tab order. Measured in Chromium (Playwright, 390): Tab lands on the button, then a second Tab lands on the hidden input, so a keyboard user presses Tab twice per date cell (the ring stays on the button through both, since PR 1724's :focus-visible and :has(> .bt-date-hidden-icon:focus)). In WebKit the button is skipped and the hidden input is the only keyboard path in, so tabIndex=-1 on the input alone would leave WebKit with no keyboard stop. Read both engines first; any fix keeps exactly one stop per cell in each and the picker opening by keyboard. Low: no data or function lost. (H111)
